title: The Azure Frost Course
summary: A school course in pale blue frost that grows from a light touch to a spear of ice and ends in one open-handed blow that stills the foe.

title: The Paired Rime Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine in which both hands lay rime in matched pairs so that one side strikes and the other binds and the pair ends in a double hold.

title: The Twin Court Chill Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine for two cultivators who fight side by side and share one ring of cold that guards both and stills the foe between them.

title: The Dual-Track Zero Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine that draws cold from the formed core down both tracks of the body at once to fix a foe's body and qi together.

title: The Wind-Sworn Frost Course
summary: A school course in which a wind-sworn student swears the cold to the wind and sends it across the field in one sworn gale of frost.

title: The Oath-Bound Rime Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine of rime held by oath so that every hold and seal lasts exactly as long as the word that set it.

title: The Plateau Frost Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine of long strides and long reach in which frost is cast far across open ground and falls from above on those who stand in it.

title: The Unwalled Frost Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine of cold from the formed core held in the open with no wall at all that turns blows and freezes the ground of the field.
